field_notes.approved_for_execution: true only after REVIEW_CHECKLIST is complete AND the user approved
field_notes.commit: pinned git commit of the upstream source, or 'local-file' when vendored here
field_notes.sha256: hash of the SKILL.md as reviewed; if it differs, the review is void
field_notes.permissions: what the skill needs: network, shell, filesystem (none|read|write), secrets
field_notes.triggers: task phrases/types that justify using this skill
field_notes.review_expires: re-review on or before this date, or on any version change

skills.source: user-provided attachment (upstream: skills.sh ecosystem); modified locally in V3 to disable auto-install

permissions.filesystem: write (only if a skill is installed)

triggers: user asks to find/discover/install a skill
user asks 'is there a skill for X'
skills.reviewed_by: static read-through by an AI assistant; not a security audit; user approval pending
skills.notes: Discovery guide only. Searching is allowed on user request; installation/execution requires separate source review and explicit approval of the exact command.
